All three of you have also noted that the updated documentation hasn't yet made it into my approval packet. And Sofia, can you confirm the east gate route map will be added to the package from the visitor-services team today? Once I have those updates in hand, I can approve a revised package reflecting the South Arcade rear-projection site, east gate entry at 7:30 PM, and no sponsor logo in the projected artwork, with sponsor credit limited to printed programs. Does that work for everyone?
